name: Priya Raman
summary: PhD student in dense retrieval and embeddings who offered feedback on the LinkMate evaluation plan.

notes.text: Priya Raman, PhD student in the NLP lab (Dr. Huang's group). Works on dense retrieval and embeddings for scientific papers. Gave a talk at the grad seminar on why BM25 is still a strong baseline. Very sharp.

Ran into Priya at the library. She said she'd be happy to look at our evaluation plan for LinkMate - recall@k, MRR, how to build the test questions. Recommended to always compare against BM25. Also loves hiking, did the John Muir Trail last summer.
